name: Charlotte Russe
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: lady fingers or stale sponge cake
ingredients.originalText: lady fingers or stale sponge cake

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon Knox gelatine, or 1 ounce sheet gelatine
ingredients.originalText: 1 teaspoon Knox gelatine, or 1 ounce sheet gelatine
ingredients.quantityText: 1 teaspoon Knox gelatine, or 1 ounce sheet gelatine

instructions.text: Line a mould or dish holding about 6 cups with lady fingers or strips of sponge cake
Trim the cake to fit into the dish
Stick lady fingers together with white of egg or dissolved gelatine to keep them in place
Put the gelatine to soak in cold water or milk
Beat in the sugar and the flavoring
Stand the gelatine over hot water and dissolve it
Rapidly mix the dissolved gelatine with the whipped cream
Turn it into the cake-lined dish
Set away to get perfectly cold before turning out to serve

source.originalInstructions:
1. Line a mould or dish holding about 6 cups with lady fingers or strips of sponge cake
2. Trim the cake to fit into the dish
3. Stick lady fingers together with white of egg or dissolved gelatine to keep them in place
4. Put the gelatine to soak in cold water or milk
5. Whip the cream
6. Beat in the sugar and the flavoring
7. Stand the gelatine over hot water and dissolve it
8. Rapidly mix the dissolved gelatine with the whipped cream
9. Turn it into the cake-lined dish
10. Set away to get perfectly cold before turning out to serve
